newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - National Australia Bank shrs hit new high.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - National Australia Bank shrs hit new high.

text.p: Shares in Australia's largest bank, National Australia Bank Ltd, rose to a record high A$14.10 on Thursday after the company released its full year profit result.
The company reported a 6.8 percent higher net profit of A$2.1 billion for the 12 months to September 30, 1996.
Analysts had an average profit forecast of A$2.01 billion.
The bank's managing director, Don Argus, said he was confident the group's performance would improve despite strong competition in all markets and subdued economic activity.
NAB said strong profit contributions had come from operations in the US, New Zealand and Britain although the Australian operations reported a slightly lower profit.
Total assets rose to A$173.71 billion from A$148.12 billion.
"It was a strong result and banks are still the high yielders. That's why you have seen good demand for NAB shares," said a Sydney-based dealer.
By 1.20 p.m. (0220 GMT), NAB shares were 20 cents higher at A$14.12 after going as high as A$14.22.
Turnover was a strong 3.32 million shares.
